publicPublicationReadback.qualification: Both responses use bundled storage; archived D1 reads and production activation were not established.

issueObservations.rationale: Current 8.7 aggregate includes both editions. The versioned 8.7.1 release enhancement is labeled Premier. Their scope remains in disagreement, and the newer aggregate does not rewrite historical entitlement.

Current Guided Response includes both editions on Cloud and CMP; the older task is Cloud-scoped and the feature matrix groups enhancements under Premier. Base availability and enhancement history require separate readings.
Current aggregate lists ES 8.5 for Malware/Phishing, but the detailed task requires Platform10.2 and ES8.6 with paired SOAR. Exact task prerequisites remain visible.
App for SOAR still contains literal 8..0 in an on-premises tested cell. The separate Export matrix explicitly includes 8.8.1 and 8.8.0. That listing cannot repair the malformed App pairing.
The pricing overview presents several models. The activity pricing FAQ is Cloud Platform-scoped, leaving ES deployment and individual contract eligibility to separate evidence.
The current aggregate lists Triage in Premier Cloud/CMP. Corrected earlier lower-edition wording remains historical. The table supplies no exact pairing or customer enablement.
The aggregate lists Cloud ES8.6+ while the linked Triage and Response tasks require ES8.7+. Exact CMP paths and paid entitlement are separate.
The Response availability column says Premier Cloud only while its compatibility bullets and task describe CMP prerequisites. That intersection remains unresolved.

The current parent counts 200 analyses per tenant per day and 20 revisions per investigation. The linked task counts first ten findings, approximately 200 per day and no rerun. The different limits are retained with their exact source sections.
Response cannot rerun or process subsequently added findings and requires frontier models. Triage revisions do not extend that component.

Current licensing describes Cloud Connected features functioning during a Premier trial while the UI shows Essentials, then recognizes the paid tier shortly after application. This is independent of expiry and pairing.

The actual Threat Graph task says Premier alpha, requires a risk-based detection and approximately one million processed events, and distinguishes test from live queues. Public wording includes those prerequisites.

The 8.8 compatibility paragraph repeats TAXII2.0. The 8.2 introduction names 2.0 and2.1 while its compatibility paragraph says1.0 and1.1. The task is native feed scope; STIX parsing and TIM Cloud authentication are separate. Exact current protocol list remains uncertain. The prior dates and assessment-time correction remain in immutable history. These three exact source sections were retrieved and assessed afresh today.

deferredConcerns: Guidance integrates the verified append against the current canonical checkpoint; the release steward independently selects Site delivery. ES Editions Watch will recheck scope on November 28.
issueFeed.qualification: Thirteen assessment records pin the independently readable public source-audit commit 85384563c6f4379f3ec006349d799d5994b29f5e. This branch binds a repository checkpoint for integration. Canonical main discovery and public Site delivery remain pending.
